Write a plot or list of plots to one or more files

Source: R/ggwrite.R
writeObj.Rd

Internal workhorse function called by ggwrite. Resolves the combination of output formats and canvas sizes (via ggwrite_names), and dispatches to write1 for each individual plot/format/canvas combination. Handles both single plot objects and lists of plots, including the onefile (multi-page PDF) case.

Usage

writeObj(
  plot,
  file,
  script,
  time,
  model = model,
  onefile,
  use.names = FALSE,
  formats,
  canvas,
  quiet = FALSE,
  fun.path,
  subdir,
  name.all.pdf = "all.pdf",
  method.png = c("ragg", "png"),
  ...
)

Arguments

plot

A plot object or a list of plot objects. See ggwrite.

file

Character string, base output file path, or NULL to only display the plot(s) on screen.

script

Character string or path to the calling script, used for stamping. See ggstamp.

time

Character string or POSIXct timestamp used for stamping.

model

Character string or model object used for stamping and path construction.

onefile

Logical. If TRUE and plot is a list, all plots are combined into a single multi-page PDF.

use.names

Logical. If plot is a list, should names(plot) be used in output file names rather than numeric indices?

formats

Character vector of file formats, a subset of c("png","pdf").

canvas

Canvas size specification. See canvasSize.

quiet

Logical. If TRUE, suppresses messages about files written.

fun.path

Function or character string defining output directory structure. See pathFormat. If the path format uses %script, script is forwarded to it automatically.

subdir

Character string, subdirectory passed on to fun.path.

name.all.pdf

Character string, file name to use for a combined multi-page PDF when file = "" and onefile = TRUE. Default "all.pdf".

method.png

Character string, one of "png" or "ragg", specifying which graphics device to use for PNG output. See write1.

...

Passed on to write1 (and ultimately to png/pdf).

Value

NULL, invisibly. Files are written (and/or plots displayed) as a side effect.

See also

ggwrite, write1, ggwrite_names
